description: This source file defines the 'ThingDefinitionModified' event class, which is emitted when the definition of a 'Thing' is modified. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, accessors for the modified definition, and serialization logic.

classes.name: ThingDefinitionModified
classes.description: Immutable event class representing a modification to a Thing's definition. Provides methods for constructing the event, serialization/deserialization, and accessing the modified definition.

methods.name: ThingDefinitionModified.of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ThingDefinitionModified with specified parameters, including optional timestamp and metadata.

methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a ThingDefinitionModified instance, using the provided headers.

methods.name: ThingDefinitionModified.setRevision
methods.description: Creates a copy of this event with an updated revision number.

methods.name: ThingDefinitionModified.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a copy of this event with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: ThingDefinitionModified.getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path resource for the definition.

methods.name: ThingDefinitionModified.getEntity
methods.description: Provides optional JSON entity representation based on schema version.
